def observables(label,d,b):

    near(label+':variance_per_site',b['variance']/n,b['variance_per_site'],1e-14)

    check(label+':variance_nonnegative_with_roundoff',b['variance']>=-b['variance_roundoff_scale'])
    col=[sum(sz[x*9:(x+1)*9]) for x in range(3)]

        near(lab+':variance',var,s['variance_left_sz'],1e-12)
        near(lab+':entropy',ent,s['entropy'],1e-12)
        near(lab+':density',mean,sum(sz[:cut]),1e-10)
        near(lab+':covariance',var,sum(zz[i][j].real for i in range(cut) for j in range(cut))-sum(sz[:cut])**2,1e-9)
    return col
